stat-number.purpose: Supporting figures in stat cards and tiles.

title.purpose: List-row titles and compact header title, system stack.

body.purpose: Running text in the system San Francisco stack.

caption.purpose: Smallest muted text; tab labels are 10.5px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Radar Teal pill, the one action on cloud and paper.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 26px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: #0a7c8f; color: #fff; font: 600 16px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b1f29; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Paper pill with a 1.5px inset ink ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-2 { min-height: 56px; padding: 0 26px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: #f8fbfb; color: #0b1f29; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #0b1f29; font: 600 16px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-2:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b1f29; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Storm Tile
components.description: Hero surface with a hero number and a lit Radar Bright action.
components.css: .ds-tile { border-radius: 24px; padding: 20px; background: #0c3a47; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #0c3a47; } .ds-tile-label { font: 500 12.5px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #9fc1ca; } .ds-tile-num { font: 600 58px/0.96 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-top: 6px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Paper surface with a hairline; flat at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #f8fbfb; border: 1px solid #cad7dc; border-radius: 20px; padding: 18px; color: #0b1f29; font: 15px/1.45 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Level Pill
components.description: Bulletin warning level with a currentColor dot. State only.
components.css: .ds-level { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 700 11px/1.3 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #faf0c4; color: #6b5200; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-level::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: 54px paper field; focus shifts border to ink with a radar glow.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 54px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1.5px solid #cad7dc; border-radius: 14px; background: #f8fbfb; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input input { flex: 1; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; font: 500 16px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0b1f29; padding: 14px 0; } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: #8aa1ab; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: #0b1f29; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, #0a7c8f 32%, transparent); }

components.name: Selected Chip
components.description: Storm pill for selected filters and options.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid #cad7dc; background: #f8fbfb; color: #0b1f29; font: 500 14px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip.on { background: #0c3a47; border-color: #0b1f29; color: #fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b1f29; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Translucent blurred iOS tab bar with a storm hub pill at centre.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); padding: 6px 8px 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #f8fbfb 84%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.5); border-top: 0.5px solid #b3c4cb; font: 500 10.5px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tabs a { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; min-height: 48px; padding-top: 4px; color: #4b6572; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tabs a.active { color: #0a7c8f; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tabs .hub span { width: 54px; height: 30px; border-radius: 15px; background: #0c3a47; color: #6fd5e3; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 18px; }

narrative.overview:
A money decision is a forecast, so the app speaks like a weather bulletin. Outcomes are ranges, not single futures. Something changes at an onset marker. State is told in a four-level warning vocabulary (ok, aware, prepare, act) instead of green up and red down. The ground is overcast cloud grey with a cool green bias, cards are paper white, hero tiles are deep storm teal, actions are radar teal, and data and estimates are rain blue.

The shell borrows iOS grammar: large titles, grouped lists, a translucent tab bar with Decide centred, pill buttons and sheets. Numerals and headings use Barlow Semi Condensed; running text uses the system San Francisco stack. Contour art on storm tiles is drawn as isobars.
keyCharacteristics: Cloud ground, paper cards, storm-teal hero surfaces, radar-teal action, rain-blue data.
Four bulletin warning colours that only ever mean state.
Condensed tabular numerals over native text.
Soft, generous radii (14 to 24px, pills for controls) and almost no shadow.
Isobar contour art on dark tiles; ranges and onset markers in charts.
Dark appearance exists as a token set, verified on Home and Decide only.
Home net worth sparkline shows actual history with no forecast band; the range band appears on multi-option charts only.

rules.name: The Reserved Weather Rule
rules.body: The four level colours (green, yellow, orange, red) mean state and nothing else. They never decorate a tile, icon, chart series or illustration.

rules.name: The Lit-On-Storm Rule
rules.body: Radar Bright appears only on storm surfaces or as a small signal. On cloud and paper, action is Radar Teal.

rules.name: The Estimate Is Indigo Rule
rules.body: Assumptions, projections and estimates are indigo or rain blue and may be dashed or hatched; they are never a level colour.

rules.name: The Numerals Are Condensed Rule
rules.body: Every currency figure is Barlow Semi Condensed with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Native Text Rule
rules.body: Prose, labels and controls use the system stack. Barlow does not set paragraphs.

rules.name: The Flat Until Floating Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat with a hairline. Only toasts, the FAB and the tab bar float.

rules.name: The Dark Is A Token Set Rule
rules.body: Dark re-values the same roles via data-theme on the screen. Verified on Home and Decide only.

dos: Do use the four level colours only to state a level (pill, dot, border, error, negative delta).
Do set every figure in Barlow Semi Condensed with tabular numerals; keep prose in the system stack.
Do use Radar Teal for action on cloud and paper, and Radar Bright with ink text on storm.
Do keep surfaces flat with a 1px line; reserve soft cool shadows (Float) for toasts and the FAB.
Do use full pills for controls and the 14 to 24px radius ladder for containers.
Do show ranges and an onset marker where a choice changes, and mark estimates in indigo, dashed or hatched.
Do keep touch targets at or above 44px.
donts: Don't use green or red for plain up or down; use level meaning or neutral ink.
Don't use a level colour as decoration in an illustration, chart series, tile or icon.
Don't put white text on Radar Bright.
Don't draw a range band on a single-series chart, or imply a forecast on the Home net worth sparkline.
Don't assume dark appearance is designed beyond Home and Decide; verify other screens before relying on it.
Don't return to the incumbent bone canvas, ink tiles and electric-lime accent.
